record_type_quote: Thus, the goal of this project reported here is to conduct a direct pre-registered replication of the box show paradigm (see Hamlin & Wynn, 2011) in attempt to assess the replicability of infants' preference for prosocial others and more broadly, help to uncover and better understand replicability issues within psychological science and more specifically within the field of developmental psychology.

targets.title: Young infants prefer prosocial to antisocial others.
targets.evidence_quote: Thus, the goal of this project reported here is to conduct a direct pre-registered replication of the box show paradigm (see Hamlin & Wynn, 2011) in attempt to assess the replicability of infants' preference for prosocial others and more broadly, help to uncover and better understand replicability issues within psychological science and more specifically within the field of developmental psychology.
targets.outcome_quote: Our pre-registered sample did not replicate the original finding seen in Hamlin & Wynn (2011). However, when including all infants tested in the box scenario, the finding did indeed replicate.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The author explicitly contrasts failure in the preregistered sample with success in the entire sample. The primary preregistered replication failed; the whole-work verdict reflects both author-reported comparisons. Other replication attempts are background, not targets.
